bottom_sheet.dart.note: dify-sf phone sheets on the framework modal bottom sheet route and DraggableScrollableSheet (raft-flutter pattern, no Dify counterpart): detents, flicks, scroll hand-over, close requests, scrim, keyboard and insets are tested; header text uses DifyText with DifyPhoneType.title / system-xs-regular. DifySheetPortal (batch 4a): the same sheet shown from a page's tree in the root overlay (keeps its scopes); DifyPortalSheetFrame; DifySheetHeader.titleWidget. Device check: DifyPortalSemantics keeps portal sheets in the platform's semantics tree (modal from the page side); DifySheetRecipe.contains. Batch 4a round 2: DifyModalLayer (a page, a portal sheet, a portal page) hides its whole content from accessibility while a modal layer opened from it is open and is that layer's semantics place, so only the topmost layer is read and it is never dropped; the portal sheet is a semantics boundary. The non-modal page sheet (DifyPersistentSheet) also slides in, dismisses (drag, controller) and moves only once its content has a single scroll view. showDifyBottomSheet backDismissible / closeOnEscape carry a dialog's dismissal rules (scrim and drag off, Back and Escape on) into its sheet form.

In a compact window's dialog (DifyDialogFrame) a button is touch-high too.

Polish (after batch 4): DifyTouchTarget.accessible (raft-flutter's RaftTouchTarget: the hit area is also the control's accessible bounds, one merged node; only inside a box of the control's own that holds the whole hit area) and DifyTouchArea.inPhoneSheet / appliesIn (a small control in a phone sheet: a 44 px box that is its accessible bounds; the control's edge must be hittable, no dead padding inside the box). PR #89 review: every reported box tapped 2 dp inside each edge in the tests.
